---
description: "Use when frontend behavior changes require validation, including routing, auth/session, forms, and state updates."
applyTo: "client/src/**"
---

# Frontend Testing Instructions

- For behavior changes, add or update tests where practical.
- Run frontend lint/build and relevant tests before finalizing.
- Manually verify critical user flows when automated coverage is missing.
- Call out any test gaps and risk areas in the final summary.
